operators.name: pixel_unshuffle_forward

returns.shape: [N, C * upscale_factor^2, H / upscale_factor, W / upscale_factor]

semantics: For each output pixel at (n, c_out, h_out, w_out), compute input coordinates: n, c_in = c_out % C, h_in = h_out * upscale_factor + (c_out // C) // upscale_factor, w_in = w_out * upscale_factor + (c_out // C) % upscale_factor.
The input is not assumed contiguous; the kernel must respect strides.
The operation is purely a data movement, no arithmetic.
Output is allocated with the same dtype and device as x, with dimensions derived from the rule.
Performs pixel unshuffle with upscale_factor=2 on input shape [512,3,512,512].
The output values are exactly the input pixels rearranged according to the unshuffle factor.
No bias, no normalization, no numeric computation besides data movement.
